geometry.display: R300 at 1x, art drawn at 0.5 (2x art)
geometry.rule: ribs(v) = round(2 + 12*clamp(ln v / ln 200)); open segments = ribs; segment i (0 = left) bisector at 90 + span/2 - (i+.5)*seg (deg ccw from +x), span = ribs*seg

animator.value: value glyph height = 0.34R * max(0.55, min(1, segmentsOpen / 5)) (x1 on the 2-rib spike = 0.55); centred at 0.6R above the pivot
animator.tassel: fan_rivet_tassel scales with the fan as now, but cap the tassel visible length at about 0.5R. Rivet and tassel are ONE sprite: at R < 200 either draw the procedural fx.js tassel or draw the sprite at 0.55 of the fan scale
animator.teeth: the painted rim tooth peaks fall MID-segment and the valleys on the seams (reverse of the fx.js zig-zag): accepted by the AD 2026-11-11
animator.shear: the fx.js closing perspective (transform(1, 0, (1-open)*.22, .68+.32*open)) can still be applied on top of the painted parts
animator.masks: mask each segment to its wedge (+-5.68 deg) and the leaf also to r >= 0.33R

geometry.draw_order: ribs (13 inner) < leaf segments < rim segments < guards < rivet+tassel; Animator masks each segment to its wedge (+-5.68 deg) and the leaf also to r >= 0.33R (the painted pleat runs in to ~0.1R)
